blurb: Modern day Karate is self-defense training that has developed from ancient Okinawan and Japanese martial arts. Those who practice “Karate-do”, the way of Karate, improve their physical fitness and skill by mastering the punching, kicking, shifting and blocking techniques fundamental to Karate training. More importantly, Karate training generates confidence and self respect, which provide valuable personal insights.
